Load the synthetic bucket and set every starter parameter explicitly.

The native Shuffle action requires labeled nonempty finite matching samples and a positive signed 32-bit pass count within 10000000 requested sample visits across the selection. It preserves coordinates, axis labels and Y multiplicities on copies, cancels quietly, and rejects invalid input before a chart or recorder entry. The desktop action exposes no seed and its validation is separate from the public legacy shuffle API.
